Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Furniture Co.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Furniture Co. operates as a retail furniture store specializing in the sale of high-quality hardwood and upholstered furniture. Our services include professional consultation, delivery, and installation to ensure customer satisfaction. We focus on sourcing furniture made from sustainably harvested materials, adhering to all regulations concerning exotic woods. With an inventory valued at approximately $750,000, we implement rigorous security measures including a centralized alarm system and regular inventory audits. Our team is trained in loss prevention strategies, and all subcontractors engaged for delivery and installation carry required insurance to mitigate risks associated with potential damage during these operations.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2022, a claim was reported for damage to a customer's hardwood floor during delivery, resulting in a repair cost of $5,000. The claim was settled and closed on 07/01/2022. On 04/10/2023, another loss occurred due to minor damage to a sofa during installation, leading to a repair reimbursement of $3,000. This claim is currently in process. Total losses amount to $8,000, with one claim filed and the other pending.
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Burglar-resistant, Class B, UL Listed Safe, 2000 lbs capacity
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Central alarm system with 24/7 monitoring, on-site security personnel during peak hours, and motion sensor lighting around the perimeter.
